stem.text: A student uses a cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO) to measure the period of a signal. She sets the time-base of the CRO to $5\,\text{ms cm}^{-1}$ and observes the trace illustrated below. The trace has a length of $10.0\,\text{cm}$.

stem.alt: Oscilloscope trace of a periodic wave between two dashed vertical lines, with a double-headed arrow labelled 10.0 cm spanning the trace.

stem.text: What is the period of the signal?
